description: DST-aware session-opening thirty-minute initial-balance failed auction to the opposite IB edge

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill costs 6 bp. A bar-only market entry reserves one tick for the synthetic executable-side crossing and one tick from OneTickSlippageFillModel. Stop execution reserves the shifted preceding-hour ten-second true-range Q99. Official funding, mark price and native liquidation remain enabled.

scenario_contract.market_mechanism: The first thirty minutes of Asia, London or New York establish a completed opening inventory. A later probe beyond one edge that closes back inside is a failed price-discovery auction only after a separate completed five-minute displacement continues away from that edge.

sessions.LONDON: 08:00 Europe/London converted to UTC for each local date
sessions.NEW_YORK: 09:30 America/New_York converted to UTC for each local date

scenario_contract.initial_balance: Exactly six contiguous completed five-minute bars; incomplete balances are unusable.
scenario_contract.failed_edge: The first later five-minute bar sweeps one IB edge by at least 0.05 completed five-minute ATR and closes strictly back inside the IB.
scenario_contract.confirmation: A separate later completed five-minute bar has directionally located close, body and range at least their shifted prior-12-bar medians, and closes through the sweep bar midpoint away from the failed edge.
scenario_contract.entry: The first contiguous completed ten-second execution observation after the confirming five-minute bar; ten-second values do not choose direction or quality.
scenario_contract.stop: Beyond the most adverse observed sweep-confirmation-execution sequence extreme plus 0.05 sweep-bar ATR, at least 0.10 ATR from entry.
scenario_contract.target: The opposite edge of the already-completed initial balance; reject if consumed before order submission.
scenario_contract.one_attempt: At most the first failed-edge auction per session is eligible; invalidated or uneconomic attempts are not retried.
